Summary: God called Abram to leave his country and family and go to a land He would show him, promising to make him a great nation and bless all peoples on earth through him. Abram obeyed by faith, and God counted his belief as righteousness and sealed His promise in a covenant.
Significance: Abraham's journey is the heartbeat of this blog's hope: God keeps covenant promises across generations. When God calls you into the unknown, the same faithful God goes with you.
Place: Ur of the Chaldeans; Haran; Canaan
